judgment.status_reasoning: J-AISI released the Approach Book on 9 Jan 2026 and its release page (re-checked unchanged on 18 Oct 2026) still lists both editions. It is a conceptual framework offered as a reference, with implementation guides and procedures to follow as related deliverables; it creates no obligations. Nothing stored shows a newer version or a withdrawal. 'Published (non-binding, current)' and 'Non-binding' stand.
